_source: Fit360OS exercise PDFs (project root): 100 Gym Exercises, 50 Home Bodyweight HIIT, 50 Warm-Ups, Post-Workout Stretching.

items.name: Barbell Bench Press
items.notes: Retract the shoulder blades, lower the bar to mid-chest, and press without bouncing.

items.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
items.notes: Use a moderate incline; keep the wrists stacked over the elbows.

items.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
items.notes: Keep the upper back tight and control the bar down to the lower chest.

items.name: Flat Dumbbell Press
items.notes: Lower with control and keep the forearms nearly vertical.

items.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
items.notes: Press up and slightly inward without clashing the dumbbells.

items.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
items.notes: Keep the shoulders packed and use a smooth full range.

items.name: Machine Chest Press
items.notes: Set the seat so the handles align around mid-chest; avoid shrugging.

items.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
items.notes: Position the bench so the bar path reaches mid-chest comfortably.

items.name: Dumbbell Fly
items.notes: Keep a soft elbow bend and stop before the shoulders overstretch.

items.name: Cable Fly - Mid
items.notes: Bring the hands together at chest height while keeping the ribs controlled.

items.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
items.notes: Sweep the handles upward and inward toward upper-chest level.

items.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
items.notes: Sweep the handles down and inward toward lower-chest / upper-ab level.

items.name: Conventional Deadlift
items.notes: Brace before lifting; keep the bar close and stand tall without leaning back.

items.name: Rack Pull
items.notes: Start from the pins, brace hard, and keep the bar close to the body.

items.name: Pull-Up
items.notes: Drive the elbows down; avoid swinging or craning the neck.

items.name: Chin-Up
items.notes: Use a supinated grip and pull the chest toward the bar under control.

items.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
items.notes: Pull toward the upper chest while keeping the torso stable.

items.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
items.notes: Lead with the elbows and avoid turning it into a row.

items.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
items.notes: Keep the arms nearly straight and pull from the shoulders to the thighs.

items.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
items.notes: Hinge at the hips, brace, and row toward the lower ribs.

items.name: Pendlay Row
items.notes: Reset the bar on the floor each rep and keep the torso close to parallel.

items.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
items.notes: Pull the elbow toward the hip and avoid twisting the torso.

items.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
items.notes: Keep the chest supported and squeeze the shoulder blades back.

items.name: Seated Cable Row
items.notes: Stay tall and pull the handle toward the lower ribs.

items.name: T-Bar Row
items.notes: Keep the spine neutral and pull the elbows behind the body.

items.name: Machine High Row
items.notes: Drive the elbows down and back; control the stretch at the top.

items.name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
items.notes: Brace the glutes and core; press overhead without an excessive back arch.

items.name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
items.notes: Keep the upper back supported and lower to a comfortable depth.

items.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
items.notes: Press smoothly overhead while keeping the forearms stacked.

items.name: Arnold Press
items.notes: Rotate gradually; use a load that allows controlled movement.

items.name: Machine Shoulder Press
items.notes: Adjust the seat so the handles begin around shoulder level.

items.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
items.notes: Lead with the elbows and raise to roughly shoulder height.

items.name: Cable Lateral Raise
items.notes: Keep the tension continuous and avoid torso swinging.

items.name: Machine Lateral Raise
items.notes: Align the machine pivot with the shoulder and lift under control.

items.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
items.notes: Raise to shoulder level without leaning backward.

items.name: Cable Front Raise
items.notes: Maintain a steady torso and a controlled eccentric.

items.name: Reverse Pec Deck
items.notes: Open the arms out while keeping the shoulders down.

items.name: Bent-Over Rear-Delt Fly
items.notes: Hinge, keep a soft elbow bend, and move from the shoulders.

items.name: Standing Barbell Curl
items.notes: Keep the elbows close to the sides and avoid hip drive.

items.name: EZ-Bar Curl
items.notes: Use a comfortable wrist angle and control the lowering phase.

items.name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
items.notes: Supinate as you curl and keep the upper arm relatively still.

items.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
items.notes: Let the arms hang back and avoid moving the shoulders forward.

items.name: Hammer Curl
items.notes: Use a neutral grip and keep the elbows tucked.

items.name: Preacher Curl
items.notes: Keep the upper arms supported and avoid hyperextending the elbows.

items.name: Cable Curl
items.notes: Keep constant tension and avoid stepping back during reps.

items.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
items.notes: Stand slightly ahead of the cable and keep the upper arm behind the torso.

items.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
items.notes: Use a shoulder-width grip and keep the elbows controlled.

items.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
items.notes: Lower toward the forehead / behind the head while keeping the upper arms stable.

items.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
items.notes: Keep the elbows pointing forward and the ribs down.

items.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
items.notes: Lock the upper arms by the sides and separate the rope at the bottom.

items.name: Straight-Bar Pushdown
items.notes: Extend fully without letting the shoulders roll forward.

items.name: Reverse-Grip Pushdown
items.notes: Use a lighter load and keep the wrists neutral.

items.name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
items.notes: Keep the elbow fixed and fully extend under control.

items.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
items.notes: Lean slightly forward and let the elbows flex before extending.

items.name: Back Squat
items.notes: Brace, keep the whole foot grounded, and track the knees with the toes.

items.name: Front Squat
items.notes: Keep the elbows high and the torso upright through the descent.

items.name: Hack Squat
items.notes: Keep the back against the pad and control the depth.

items.name: Leg Press
items.notes: Lower until comfortable without the pelvis curling off the pad.

items.name: Smith Machine Squat
items.notes: Set the feet to suit the fixed bar path and keep the knees tracking well.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.notes: Use a stable stance and descend straight down.

items.name: Walking Lunge
items.notes: Take controlled steps and maintain balance through each rep.

items.name: Reverse Lunge
items.notes: Step back softly and drive through the front foot.

items.name: Leg Extension
items.notes: Align the knee with the machine pivot and squeeze at the top.

items.name: Sissy Squat
items.notes: Use support, keep the hips extended, and work only within a comfortable range.

items.name: Romanian Deadlift
items.notes: Push the hips back, keep the bar close, and stop when the hamstrings limit the range.

items.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
items.notes: Hinge rather than squat and keep the weights close to the legs.

items.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
items.notes: Use a controlled range and maintain a stable neutral spine.

items.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
items.notes: Tuck the ribs, drive through the feet, and finish with the glutes.

items.name: Machine Hip Thrust
items.notes: Set the pad securely and avoid overextending the lower back.

items.name: Glute Bridge
items.notes: Drive the hips up while keeping the ribs down.

items.name: Lying Leg Curl
items.notes: Keep the hips pressed into the pad and curl smoothly.

items.name: Seated Leg Curl
items.notes: Keep the thighs secured and control the stretched position.

items.name: Standing Single-Leg Curl
items.notes: Keep the hips square and isolate one leg at a time.

items.name: Cable Pull-Through
items.notes: Hinge the hips back, then extend the hips without pulling with the arms.

items.name: Cable Glute Kickback
items.notes: Keep the pelvis square and avoid arching the lower back.

items.name: 45-Degree Back Extension
items.notes: Hinge at the hips and finish in a straight line, not a hyperextension.

items.name: Standing Calf Raise
items.notes: Use a full controlled stretch and rise onto the balls of the feet.

items.name: Seated Calf Raise
items.notes: Pause briefly at the stretch and at the top position.

items.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
items.notes: Move through the ankles only and keep the knees nearly fixed.

items.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
items.notes: Use a stable foot position and a full ankle range.

items.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
items.notes: Use support for balance and work each side evenly.

items.name: Donkey Calf Raise
items.notes: Keep the hips hinged and focus on controlled ankle movement.

items.name: Cable Crunch
items.notes: Flex the trunk by bringing the ribs toward the pelvis; avoid pulling with the arms.

items.name: Machine Ab Crunch
items.notes: Adjust the pad position and curl through the trunk under control.

items.name: Hanging Knee Raise
items.notes: Posteriorly tilt the pelvis at the top instead of only lifting the knees.

items.name: Hanging Leg Raise
items.notes: Control the swing and raise the legs only as high as the position allows.

items.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
items.notes: Keep the back supported and curl the pelvis upward.

items.name: Decline Sit-Up
items.notes: Use controlled trunk flexion and avoid pulling the neck.

items.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
items.notes: Brace and extend only as far as you can keep the ribs and pelvis controlled.

items.name: Pallof Press
items.notes: Press straight out while resisting torso rotation.

items.name: Cable Wood Chop
items.notes: Rotate through the torso and hips in a controlled pattern.

items.name: Weighted Plank
items.notes: Maintain a straight line and avoid dropping or piking the hips.

items.name: Barbell Shrug
items.notes: Elevate the shoulders straight up; avoid rolling them.

items.name: Dumbbell Shrug
items.notes: Pause at the top and lower under control.

items.name: Smith Machine Shrug
items.notes: Stand tall and shrug vertically.

items.name: Farmer's Carry
items.notes: Walk tall with the ribs stacked and the shoulders stable.

items.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
items.notes: Support the forearms and move only through the wrists.

items.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
items.notes: Use a light load and controlled wrist extension.

items.name: Reverse Barbell Curl
items.notes: Use a pronated grip and keep the elbows fixed.

items.name: Plate Pinch Hold
items.notes: Pinch the plates securely and keep the wrist neutral.

items.name: Jumping Jacks
items.notes: Land softly with the knees slightly bent; keep a steady rhythm. Easier: step one foot out at a time instead of jumping.

items.name: High Knees
items.notes: Run in place and drive the knees upward while keeping the torso tall. Easier: march quickly with controlled knee lifts.

items.name: Butt Kicks
items.notes: Jog in place and bring the heels toward the glutes without leaning forward. Easier: alternate heel curls without hopping.

items.name: Skater Steps
items.notes: Move side to side, loading the outside leg and keeping the hips back. Easier: step laterally without the hop.

items.name: Fast Feet
items.notes: Stay light on the balls of the feet and take quick short steps. Easier: slow the cadence while maintaining movement.

items.name: Seal Jacks
items.notes: Jump the feet apart while opening the arms; close the arms and feet together. Easier: step side to side while opening and closing the arms.

items.name: Power March
items.notes: Drive the opposite arm and knee with a fast marching rhythm. Easier: reduce the knee height and pace.

items.name: Lateral Line Hops
items.notes: Hop side to side over an imaginary line with soft, quick landings. Easier: step side to side over the line.

items.name: Front-Back Line Hops
items.notes: Hop forward and backward over an imaginary line while staying light. Easier: step forward and backward quickly.

items.name: Shadow Boxing
items.notes: Punch quickly while rotating lightly through the torso and keeping the guard up. Easier: use slower punches and smaller torso rotation.

items.name: Mountain Climber
items.notes: Alternate knee drives quickly while maintaining a strong plank line. Easier: slow the knee drives.

items.name: Plank Jack
items.notes: Jump the feet apart and together without letting the hips bounce. Easier: step one foot out at a time.

items.name: Squat Thrust
items.notes: Squat down, place the hands, jump to a plank, jump back in, then stand tall. Easier: step the feet back and in instead of jumping.

items.name: Burpee
items.notes: Move from standing to a plank and back smoothly; land softly on the jump. Easier: remove the push-up and/or jump; step back instead.

items.name: Half Burpee
items.notes: From a plank, jump the feet toward the hands and back to a plank without standing up. Easier: step the feet forward and back one at a time.

items.name: Bodyweight Squat
items.notes: Sit the hips down and back, keep the whole foot planted, and track the knees over the toes. Easier: use a chair as a depth target.

items.name: Squat Pulse
items.notes: Hold the lower half of the squat and pulse through a small controlled range. Easier: use a shallower squat.

items.name: Jump Squat
items.notes: Explode upward, then land softly and immediately control the next squat. Easier: fast bodyweight squats without jumping.

items.name: Reverse Lunge (Bodyweight)
items.notes: Step backward, lower both knees, and drive through the front foot to return. Easier: reduce the lunge depth.

items.name: Alternating Forward Lunge
items.notes: Step forward under control and push back to the start without wobbling. Easier: use reverse lunges instead.

items.name: Lateral Lunge
items.notes: Step wide, sit into one hip, and keep the opposite leg long. Easier: shorten the side step.

items.name: Curtsy Lunge
items.notes: Step one leg diagonally behind while keeping the front knee aligned. Easier: use a regular reverse lunge.

items.name: Split Squat
items.notes: Stay in a staggered stance and lower vertically through both knees. Easier: hold a wall for balance.

items.name: Alternating Jump Lunge
items.notes: Switch legs in the air and land softly into the next lunge. Easier: alternate reverse lunges without jumping.

items.name: Glute Bridge (Bodyweight)
items.notes: Drive through the heels, squeeze the glutes, and avoid over-arching the lower back. Easier: use a smaller range of motion.

items.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
items.notes: Keep the pelvis level while extending the hips from one planted foot. Easier: use the two-leg glute bridge.

items.name: Donkey Kick
items.notes: Keep the core braced and drive one heel upward without twisting the pelvis. Easier: use a smaller hip-extension range.

items.name: Fire Hydrant
items.notes: Lift the bent knee out to the side while keeping the hips square. Easier: reduce the lift height.

items.name: Calf Raise (Bodyweight)
items.notes: Rise onto the balls of the feet, pause briefly, and lower with control. Easier: hold a wall for balance.

items.name: Wall Sit
items.notes: Keep the back against the wall and hold a comfortable knee angle. Easier: stand slightly higher to reduce intensity.

items.name: Push-Up
items.notes: Keep the body in one line and lower the chest between the hands under control. Easier: perform from the knees.

items.name: Knee Push-Up
items.notes: Maintain a straight line from the knees to the head and lower the chest smoothly. Easier: use a shorter range.

items.name: Wide Push-Up
items.notes: Place the hands wider than the shoulders and keep the elbows controlled, not flared excessively. Easier: perform from the knees.

items.name: Diamond Push-Up
items.notes: Keep the hands close under the chest and the elbows tracking back. Easier: use the knees or widen the hand position slightly.

items.name: Pike Push-Up
items.notes: Lift the hips high and lower the head between the hands with control. Easier: reduce the hip height.

items.name: Shoulder Tap
items.notes: From a high plank, touch the opposite shoulder while resisting hip rotation. Easier: widen the feet or perform from the knees.

items.name: Plank Up-Down
items.notes: Alternate between the forearms and the hands while keeping the hips steady. Easier: perform from the knees.

items.name: Inchworm Walkout
items.notes: Hinge forward, walk the hands to a plank, then walk back without rushing. Easier: bend the knees more during the hinge.

items.name: Bear Plank Shoulder Tap
items.notes: Hover the knees just off the floor and tap the opposite shoulder without shifting the hips. Easier: keep the knees on the floor.

items.name: Scapular Push-Up
items.notes: Keep the elbows straight and move only the shoulder blades together and apart. Easier: perform from the knees.

items.name: Forearm Plank
items.notes: Squeeze the glutes and keep the ribs stacked over the pelvis without sagging. Easier: perform from the knees.

items.name: Side Plank
items.notes: Keep the hips lifted and the body in a straight line. Easier: bend the lower knee for support.

items.name: Dead Bug
items.notes: Keep the lower back gently braced as the opposite arm and leg extend. Easier: move only the legs or shorten the lever.

items.name: Bicycle Crunch
items.notes: Rotate the rib cage toward the opposite knee rather than pulling the neck. Easier: keep the feet closer to the floor.

items.name: Reverse Crunch
items.notes: Curl the pelvis toward the ribs using abdominal control, not momentum. Easier: use a smaller pelvic curl.

items.name: Straight-Leg Raise
items.notes: Keep the lower back controlled as the legs lower; stop before the back arches. Easier: bend the knees.

items.name: Flutter Kicks
items.notes: Keep the legs long and make small alternating kicks while bracing the trunk. Easier: raise the legs higher or bend the knees.

items.name: Heel Taps
items.notes: Crunch slightly and reach side to side toward each heel. Easier: bring the heels closer to the hips.

items.name: Plank Knee-to-Elbow
items.notes: From a high plank, drive the knee toward the same-side elbow without bouncing. Easier: move slowly or use an elevated surface.

items.name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
items.notes: Drive the knee toward the opposite elbow while keeping the shoulders over the hands. Easier: slow to a controlled cross-body knee drive.

items.name: Arm Circles - Forward
items.notes: Start small and gradually increase the circle size without shrugging.

items.name: Arm Circles - Backward
items.notes: Keep the ribs down and move smoothly through a comfortable range.

items.name: Alternating Arm Swings
items.notes: Open the arms wide, then cross them gently in front of the chest.

items.name: Overhead Arm Reach
items.notes: Reach tall overhead without excessive lower-back arching.

items.name: Shoulder CARs
items.notes: Make slow controlled circles while keeping the torso still.

items.name: Scapular Retraction
items.notes: Pull the shoulder blades gently back and down without bending the elbows.

items.name: Scapular Protraction
items.notes: Reach the shoulder blades forward while keeping the arms straight.

items.name: Wall Slides
items.notes: Keep the ribs controlled and slide the arms upward without forcing the range.

items.name: Wall Angels
items.notes: Keep the upper back against the wall and move slowly.

items.name: Push-Up Plus
items.notes: Keep the elbows straight at the top and actively push the floor away.

items.name: Scapular Push-Ups
items.notes: Move only the shoulder blades while maintaining a strong plank.

items.name: Knee Push-Ups (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Use a controlled range and keep the body aligned from the knees to the head.

items.name: Incline Push-Ups
items.notes: Keep a straight body line and lower under control.

items.name: Inchworm Walkouts
items.notes: Walk the hands to a plank, pause, then walk back without rushing.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.notes: Move gently between spinal flexion and extension with your breathing.

items.name: Quadruped T-Spine Rotation
items.notes: Rotate through the upper back while keeping the hips relatively still.

items.name: Thread the Needle
items.notes: Reach under the body, then rotate open through a comfortable range.

items.name: Open Book Rotation
items.notes: Keep the knees stacked and rotate the upper arm across the body.

items.name: Standing T-Spine Rotation
items.notes: Rotate smoothly while keeping the hips mostly facing forward.

items.name: W to Y Raises
items.notes: Form a W with the arms, then reach into a Y without shrugging.

items.name: Prone Y Raises
items.notes: Lift the arms slightly off the floor with the thumbs up and the neck relaxed.

items.name: Prone T Raises
items.notes: Raise the arms out to the sides and squeeze the shoulder blades gently.

items.name: Band Pull-Aparts
items.notes: Keep the elbows soft and pull the band apart at chest height.

items.name: Band External Rotation
items.notes: Keep the elbow close to the body and rotate the forearm outward slowly.

items.name: Light Band Face Pull
items.notes: Pull toward eye level and finish with the shoulder blades back and down.

items.name: Ankle Circles
items.notes: Move slowly through the full comfortable ankle range.

items.name: Ankle Rockers
items.notes: Drive the knee forward over the toes while keeping the heel down.

items.name: Heel-to-Toe Rocks
items.notes: Rock smoothly from the heels to the balls of the feet.

items.name: Standing Knee Hugs
items.notes: Pull one knee gently toward the chest while staying tall.

items.name: Walking Knee Hugs
items.notes: Alternate legs and maintain balance between steps.

items.name: Standing Quad Pull
items.notes: Bring the heel toward the glute while keeping the knees close together.

items.name: Walking Quad Pull
items.notes: Pause briefly in each stretch without arching the lower back.

items.name: Front Leg Swings
items.notes: Swing from the hip with a controlled range, not momentum.

items.name: Side-to-Side Leg Swings
items.notes: Keep the torso tall and swing the leg across and out smoothly.

items.name: Hip Circles
items.notes: Make controlled circles without twisting the whole torso.

items.name: Hip CARs
items.notes: Lift and rotate the hip slowly while keeping the pelvis controlled.

items.name: Bodyweight Squats (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Keep the whole foot grounded and the knees tracking with the toes.

items.name: Squat-to-Stand
items.notes: Hold the toes, lift the hips, then sink back into a deep comfortable squat.

items.name: Squat Pry
items.notes: Sit into a comfortable squat and gently shift side to side.

items.name: Reverse Lunges (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Step back softly and drive through the front foot to return.

items.name: Forward Lunges (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Step forward under control and keep the front knee aligned.

items.name: Lateral Lunges (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Sit into one hip while keeping the opposite leg long.

items.name: Cossack Squats
items.notes: Shift side to side through a comfortable depth with the chest tall.

items.name: World's Greatest Stretch
items.notes: Step into a long lunge, place a hand down, and rotate the chest open.

items.name: Walking Lunge with Reach
items.notes: Lunge forward and reach overhead without losing pelvic control.

items.name: Glute Bridges (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes without hyperextending the back.

items.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Keep the hips level and press through one planted foot.

items.name: Fire Hydrants (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Lift the bent knee outward without rotating the pelvis.

items.name: Donkey Kicks (Warm-Up)
items.notes: Drive the heel upward while keeping the core braced and the pelvis square.

items.name: Mini-Band Lateral Walks
items.notes: Stay slightly bent at the hips and knees and keep constant band tension.

items.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
items.notes: Place the forearm on a doorway, step forward gently, and rotate the chest away until a mild stretch is felt.

items.name: Single-Arm Wall Chest Stretch
items.notes: Place one palm on a wall at shoulder height and slowly turn the body away without forcing the shoulder.

items.name: Hands-Clasped Chest Opener
items.notes: Clasp the hands behind the body, straighten the arms gently, and lift slightly while keeping the ribs controlled.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.notes: Sit the hips toward the heels, reach the arms forward, and breathe slowly into the back and rib cage.

items.name: Bench Lat Stretch
items.notes: Place the elbows or hands on a bench and sink the chest downward while keeping the spine long.

items.name: Standing Lat Stretch
items.notes: Reach one arm overhead, hold a support if needed, and gently lean away from the stretching side.

items.name: Kneeling Side Lat Stretch
items.notes: From kneeling, place one hand farther forward and slightly across the body, then sit the hips back.

items.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
items.notes: Bring one arm across the chest and gently draw it closer with the opposite arm without shrugging.

items.name: Overhead Shoulder Flexion Stretch
items.notes: Reach both arms overhead and slightly back while keeping the ribs down and the neck relaxed.

items.name: Sleeper Stretch - Gentle
items.notes: Lie on one side with the shoulder and elbow bent about 90 degrees, then gently guide the forearm downward.

items.name: Rear Shoulder Wall Stretch
items.notes: Place the back of one arm against a wall and rotate the torso gently away.

items.name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
items.notes: Sit or stand tall, gently tilt one ear toward the same-side shoulder, and keep the opposite shoulder relaxed.

items.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
items.notes: Turn the head about 45 degrees, look gently toward the armpit, and apply only light hand pressure if needed.

items.name: Wall Biceps Stretch
items.notes: Place the palm on a wall behind you with the arm straight, then slowly rotate the torso away.

items.name: Standing Biceps Opener
items.notes: Interlace the fingers behind the back, straighten the elbows gently, and keep the shoulders down.

items.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
items.notes: Bend one elbow overhead and gently guide it with the opposite hand while keeping the torso upright.

items.name: Wall Triceps-Lat Stretch
items.notes: Place one elbow on a wall above shoulder height and sink the chest slightly while keeping the ribs controlled.

items.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
items.notes: Extend one arm with the palm up and gently pull the fingers downward and back with the opposite hand.

items.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
items.notes: Extend one arm with the palm down and gently bend the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor.

items.name: Standing Quad Stretch
items.notes: Hold one ankle behind you, keep the knees close, and gently tuck the pelvis instead of arching the back.

items.name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
items.notes: Lie on one side, hold the top ankle, and draw the heel toward the glute while keeping the hips stacked.

items.name: Couch Stretch
items.notes: Place the rear shin against a wall or bench and keep the torso tall while gently squeezing the rear glute.

items.name: Seated Single-Leg Hamstring Stretch
items.notes: Extend one leg, hinge forward from the hips, and keep the spine long rather than rounding deeply.

items.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
items.notes: Place one heel on a low surface, keep the knee soft, and hinge forward until a mild stretch is felt.

items.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
items.notes: Lie on the back and gently raise one leg using a strap or the hands behind the thigh without locking the knee.

items.name: Figure-Four Stretch
items.notes: Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh and gently draw the legs toward the chest.

items.name: Seated Figure-Four Stretch
items.notes: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and hinge forward with a long spine.

items.name: Pigeon Stretch - Modified
items.notes: Bring one shin forward and extend the other leg back; keep the hips as square and supported as possible.

items.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
items.notes: From a half-kneeling stance, tuck the pelvis slightly and shift forward without arching the lower back.

items.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor with Side Reach
items.notes: Hold the hip-flexor position and reach the same-side arm overhead, leaning gently away.

items.name: Butterfly Stretch
items.notes: Bring the soles of the feet together and let the knees fall outward while keeping the spine tall.

items.name: Wide-Knee Adductor Rock-Back
items.notes: From hands and knees, widen the knees and gently sit the hips back while keeping the spine neutral.

items.name: Standing Wall Calf Stretch
items.notes: Keep the back knee straight and the heel down while leaning toward the wall.

items.name: Bent-Knee Calf Stretch
items.notes: Keep the heel down and bend the back knee slightly while shifting forward.

items.name: Sphinx Stretch
items.notes: Lie face down and prop onto the forearms, lifting the chest gently without compressing the lower back.

items.name: Gentle Cobra Stretch
items.notes: Press up only to a comfortable height, keep the shoulders down, and avoid forcing lumbar extension.

items.name: Standing Side Bend
items.notes: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side while keeping the pelvis stable.

items.name: Supine Spinal Twist
items.notes: Lie on the back, bring one knee across the body, and keep both shoulders relaxed toward the floor.

items.name: Knees-to-Chest Stretch
items.notes: Lie on the back and draw both knees toward the chest while relaxing the shoulders and breathing slowly.

items.name: Full-Body Supine Reach
items.notes: Lie on the back and reach the arms overhead while lengthening the legs in the opposite direction without straining.
